senses.gloss:
वृंह् वृंह् (= rts. 2. वृह्, बृंह्, 2. बृह्),
cl. 1. P. वृंहति, वृंहितुम्, to grow, in-
crease; to roar, bellow (frequently applied to the
noise made by elephants); cl. 1. and 10. P. वृं-
हति, वृंहयति, to speak; to shine: Caus. वृं-
हयति, -यितुम्, to cause to increase, to augment,
strengthen, fatten; [cf. Gr. βράχω, βράζω, βράγχος,
βρόγχος, βρόχθος, (probably also) βράσσω, βρυχάομαι;
ῥόχθος, ὀρεχθέω, ῥαχία, ῥέγχω, ῥόγχος.]

वृंहण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, causing to increase,
nourishing, fostering, fattening, nutritious; (अस्), m.
a kind of sweetmeat (made of sugar, milk, spices, &c.
fried in ghee, and powdered with coarse sugar, &c.);
(अम्), n. the act of fattening, nourishing.
—वृंहण-
त्व, अम्, n. the quality of strengthening.

वृंहणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased; to be
nourished or fatted or strengthened.

वृंहत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, growing, increasing; roar-
ing, bellowing, making a cry.
वृंहयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be increased, &c.

वृंहित, अस्, आ, अम्, grown, increased; cherished,
nourished; (अम्), n. the roar or noise made by ele-
phants; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending
on Skanda (also written वृंहिला).

वृन्ताक, अस्, ई, m. f. the egg-plant, Solanum
Melongena (= वार्ताक).
—वृन्ताक-विधि, इस्, m.,
N. of a chapter of the Bhaviṣyottara-Purāṇa.

वृन्तिता, f. the medicinal plant Wrightea Anti-
dysenterica.

वृन्द वृन्द, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 98. fr. rt. वृ), numerous, many, much, all;
(अम्), n. a heap, multitude, large number, quantity,
aggregation; a flock, drove; (आ), f., N. of the forest
in which Kṛṣṇa was educated; sacred basil, Ocy-
mum Sanctum, = तुलसी; (अस्), m., N. of the author
of a work on medicine.
—वृन्दा-वन, अम्, n. a
wood near the town Gokula in the district of Ma-
thurā on the left bank of the Jumnā (celebrated as
the place where Kṛṣṇa in the character of Go-pāla, or
cowherd, passed his youth, associating with the cow-
herds and milkmaids employed in tending the cattle
grazing in the forest); a raised platform or mound
of earth on which the worshippers of Kṛṣṇa plant
and preserve the Tulasī; (ई), f. holy basil (= तुलसी).
—वृन्दावन-वर्णन, अम्, n. ‘description of
Vṛndā-vana,’ N. of a chapter of the Pātāla-khaṇḍa
of the Padma-Purāṇa.

वृन्दार, अस्, आ, अम्, much, great; best, excel-
lent, eminent; beautiful, handsome, pleasing.

वृन्दिन् in अश्व-वृन्दिन्, ई, इनी, इ, consisting of
a large number of horses.

वृन्दिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of वृन्दार),
very much or great; very excellent, very eminent or
venerable; most beautiful or charming.

वृन्दीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, very much or great; very
eminent or excellent.
